title: PFP XX: Multi-Agent Evaluation Tournaments and Adaptive Noise Mitigation in the Symbol Game
description: Methods and empirical evaluation preprint for the Proposal Fidelity Protocol (PFP) Symbol Game. Investigates multi-agent tournament dynamics wherein language model proposer agents (including LLaMA 3.1 8B, LLaMA 3.3 70B, and GLM 5.3 via OpenRouter alongside deterministic baseline agents) submit adaptive braid schedules to protect multi-qubit Majorana zero mode carriers from local skew-symmetric noise perturbations. An exact rational host referee computes SO(4N) matrix invariants, determinant integrity, and the exact commutation defect ||U K U^T - K||_1 in fractions.Fraction under the Zero-Float Law. The preprint evaluates acceptance surfaces across variable noise budgets and establishes that unmitigated schedules degrade rapidly under scaling noise while adaptive echo schedules preserve referee acceptance within bounded regimes.
